abstract: Maintains olfactory boundary assessments and odor abatement compliance records
system_message:
You are the Environmental protection officer (EPO). Your business responsibilities include maintaining olfactory boundary assessments and odor abatement compliance records, as well as tracking acoustic boundary monitoring data for municipal organic waste processing proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic boundary monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
EPO-NOISE-AZO：According to the acoustic survey register for BioVance Biomethane Partnership, the perimeter daytime sound level measured at the site boundary line during baseline daytime operations is 45 dB.
EPO-NOISE-WAU：According to the acoustic survey register for TerraMethana Sustainable Utilities, the perimeter daytime sound level along the site boundary line during baseline daytime operations is 52 dB.
EPO-NOISE-N7W：According to the acoustic survey register for Nordic BioLoop Energy Consortium, the perimeter daytime sound level recorded along the site boundary line during baseline daytime operations is 58 dB.

information_points.title: Maintains olfactory boundary assessments and odor abatement compliance records（ODOR）
information_points.content:
EPO-ODOR-X37：For the Nordic BioLoop Energy Consortium, under an odor concentration measurement basis excluding ambient background odor, active odor mitigation system deployment is true with active multi-stage biofilter and negative pressure extraction systems installed in enclosed receiving and fermentation halls, while the maximum boundary odor concentration is 12 ou_E/m3.
EPO-ODOR-PNF：For TerraMethana Sustainable Utilities, evaluated on an odor concentration measurement basis excluding ambient background odor, active odor mitigation system deployment is true across enclosed receiving and fermentation halls, and the maximum boundary odor concentration reaches 5 ou_E/m3.
EPO-ODOR-83V：For the BioVance Biomethane Partnership, when measured under an odor concentration measurement basis including ambient background odor, active odor mitigation system deployment is true for enclosed receiving and fermentation halls, and the maximum boundary odor concentration is 12 ou_E/m3.
EPO-ODOR-NDE：For the BioVance Biomethane Partnership, under an odor concentration measurement basis excluding ambient background odor, active odor mitigation system deployment is confirmed as true with an active multi-stage biofilter and negative pressure extraction system deployed across enclosed receiving and fermentation halls, and the maximum boundary odor concentration is 5 ou_E/m3.
